attchmntText: Maharashtra Seamless Limited has informed the Exchange about Presentation
voiceSummary: Maharashtra Seamless filed its earnings presentation for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The company reported total revenue of Rs. 1268 crore and profit after tax of Rs. 78 crore for Q2 FY27. EBITDA stood at Rs. 133 crore with a margin of 11%. The order book as of 10 November 2026 was Rs. 2203 crore. The company maintains a net cash position of Rs. 3701 crore. Capital expenditure of Rs. 852 crore is planned for capacity enhancement and upgrades, funded through internal accruals. Promoters hold 70.30% of shares.

attchmntText: Maharashtra Seamless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Manish Kumar Khandelwal as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Maharashtra Seamless Limited reported un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13th November 2026. Net profit after tax for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 78.24 crores. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, net profit after tax was Rs. 349.02 crores. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 1,269.80 crores. Earning per share for the quarter was Rs. 5.84. The Board also appointed Mr. Manish Kumar Khandelwal as Chief Financial Officer with effect from 13th November 2026. The financial results were reviewed by statutory auditors M/s Kanodia Sanyal & Associates.

attchmntText: Maharashtra Seamless Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Maharashtra Seamless Limited has announced an earnings call for the second quarter of the fiscal year twenty twenty seven. The management will meet investors on Saturday, November fourteenth, twenty twenty six. The event is scheduled for eleven hundred hours Indian Standard Time. The organizer is ICICI Securities Limited. The meeting will be held as a virtual conference call. Participants can join via a registration link provided in the announcement. Dial-in numbers are available for domestic and international access. The stock code is five zero zero two six five and the scrip code is MAHSEAMLES. This notice is issued pursuant to Regulation thirty of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, twenty fifteen. The company secretary, Ram Ji Nigam, signed the communication on November tenth, twenty twenty six.
